<thought>Using the most intense peak (m/z 262.0994) as the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is ≈262.0994 – 1.0073 = 261.0921 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₁₁H₁₇O₇ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 261.0974 Da, within typical high‑resolution error). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C11H17O7.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H17O7</final_answer>
